explanation: The requested eta-production point is below the physical p+eta threshold. The supplied EXCLURAD eta source uses m_p = 0.938 GeV and m_eta = 0.54786 GeV, so W_threshold = 1.48586 GeV; requested W = 1.45 GeV. Therefore no physical Born cross section or radiative-correction delta exists, and EXCLURAD was not run for this unphysical point.
